record.summary: The crash-consistent memory of the orchestrator: an append-only, hash-linked JSONL journal using the attest-ledger record envelope (canonical key-sorted JSON, sha256 chain, seq = line index), with the two properties the family's existing ledger lacks: real durability (fsync before acknowledge) and O(1) appends (in-memory head cache). State is recovered by folding the journal, never trusted from memory. Intent is journaled before a mutation and outcome after it, so a crash between the two is detectable and a resumed run reads exactly what was and was not done.
record.title: Durable hash-linked work journal
